world.title: Live Q&A: What Putin's China Visit Means for Beijing’s Ties With Russia and the US
world.summary: Russia and China are enhancing their alliance by signing 20 agreements covering trade, technology, and energy. This development follows US President Donald Trump's visit to Beijing. The countries issued a joint statement emphasizing the importance of maintaining a multi-polar world. The agreements signify a deepening partnership amid growing tensions between the US and both nations.

world.title: The Russia-China gas deal India was waiting for - and how it directly impacts your wallet
world.summary: Russia and China are advancing a significant gas pipeline deal, the ‘Power of Siberia 2,’ amid ongoing geopolitical tensions affecting energy markets. This development is particularly relevant for India, as it could influence global energy flows and prices. The deal comes at a time of supply disruptions and price volatility, particularly in the Strait of Hormuz region.

world.title: Iran claims unused modern weapons ready if US resumes attacks
world.summary: An Iranian military source informed RIA Novosti that Iran has developed modern weapons that remain unused in conflicts with the US and Israel. The source warned that Iran would not exercise restraint if the US resumes attacks. Tehran emphasizes its capability to respond with these domestically produced weapons, indicating a readiness for potential escalation in military confrontations.

business.title: Nissan Tekton Mid-Size SUV Debut Date 9th July - Petrol, Hybrid
business.summary: Nissan Motor India Pvt Ltd will debut the Tekton mid-size SUV on July 9 in Mumbai. This new model will expand Nissan's SUV portfolio in the mainstream segment and will share many features with the new Duster. The Tekton will be available in both petrol and hybrid variants, marking a significant addition to the company's offerings.

business.title: Adani Power inks deals to buy Jaiprakash Power stake, Churk assets for over Rs 4,193 crore total
business.summary: Adani Power will acquire a significant stake in Jaiprakash Power Ventures and a thermal power plant for over Rs 4,193 crore. This acquisition is part of a resolution plan for Jaiprakash Associates and aims to enhance Adani Power's generation capacity in the thermal sector. The deal is expected to finalize within 90 days, pending NCLT approval.

business.title: Stocks to watch, May 21: Engineers India, ITC, Reliance Industries, LIC, Lenskart, Anant Raj, IGIL
business.summary: Lenskart Solutions reported an 8.49% year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit for Q4 FY26, totaling ₹200.28 crore. Stocks to watch include Engineers India, ITC, Reliance Industries, LIC, Lenskart, Anant Raj, and IGIL. Nvidia's earnings are also under global scrutiny, as its GPUs are integral to AI workloads and large-scale data centers, influencing market trends.

technology.title: Apple Unveils Enhanced Accessibility with Apple Intelligence
technology.summary: Apple plans to launch significant enhancements to its accessibility features in 2026, utilizing Apple Intelligence to improve user experience across iPhone, Vision Pro, and future devices. These updates aim to promote inclusivity by providing advanced tools and functionalities tailored for individuals with disabilities. The initiative reflects Apple's commitment to making technology more accessible for all users.

technology.title: Android 17's media player carousel gets a card-based redesign in QPR1 Beta 3
technology.summary: Android 17 QPR1 Beta 3 introduces a card-based redesign for its media player carousel. This update enhances the user interface without overhauling the existing features. The redesign aims to improve accessibility and usability for users, reflecting Google's ongoing efforts to refine essential components of the Android experience. The changes are part of the regular updates to the media player functionality.

technology.title: Android Auto to get a major design change, widgets, better music apps
technology.summary: Google announced a significant redesign of Android Auto at the Google I/O 2026 event. The updated version will feature a new user interface, improved music applications, and support for widgets. Additionally, it will adapt to various display sizes and shapes, enhancing user experience. These changes aim to provide a more versatile and user-friendly interface for drivers.

sports.title: IPL 2026 scripts history! Kolkata Knight Riders’ win over Mumbai Indians sets an all-time record
sports.summary: Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) achieved a historic milestone in IPL 2026 by defeating Mumbai Indians (MI) by four wickets. This victory marked the 42nd win of the season for teams batting second, setting a new record. The match took place on Wednesday night in New Delhi, highlighting KKR's performance and contributing to the ongoing excitement of the tournament.

sports.title: The forgotten IPL OG: How cricket repaid Manish Pandey in Kolkata
sports.summary: Manish Pandey, a veteran of all 19 IPL seasons, has faced limited opportunities, batting only 28 times in six years. However, during a crucial match at Eden Gardens, he played a significant role in KKR's playoff aspirations. His consistent presence and reliability highlight the often-overlooked contributions of players like him in high-stakes situations within the IPL.

sports.title: BCCI worried whether Rohit Sharma can stay fit till 2027 ODI World Cup
sports.summary: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is concerned about Rohit Sharma's fitness ahead of the 2027 ODI World Cup. As selectors strategize for next year's tournament in South Africa, Sharma's ability to maintain fitness is under scrutiny. His recent performance in the IPL has raised questions about his longevity in the sport.

health.title: Ebola outbreak: Centre reviews preparedness as death toll crosses 100 in DR Congo, Uganda
health.summary: Union health secretary Punya Salila Srivastava led a high-level meeting with health secretaries from all states and Union territories to assess preparedness and response measures against Ebola virus disease. This meeting comes as the death toll from the outbreak has surpassed 100 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, prompting urgent discussions on public health strategies.

health.title: WHO Warns of Growing Emergency, ETHealthworld
health.summary: The World Health Organization has reported that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has been ongoing for two months, resulting in over 130 deaths. The WHO emphasizes the necessity for urgent action to contain the outbreak, warning that it may continue to expand if not addressed promptly. The situation is classified as a growing emergency.

health.title: India on High Alert as Deadly Ebola Outbreak Spreads Across Central Africa
health.summary: India has heightened its public health measures in response to the World Health Organization's declaration of a global health emergency due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Although no cases have been reported in India, authorities are increasing screening and surveillance as the death toll in Congo surpasses 130, raising concerns about the outbreak.

science.title: Nasa's Psyche spacecraft swings by Mars en route to metal-rich asteroid; see pics
science.summary: NASA's Psyche spacecraft successfully executed a flyby of Mars, obtaining detailed images of the planet, including the prominent Huygens Crater. This maneuver is part of its journey towards a metal-rich asteroid, covering a distance of approximately one billion miles. The spacecraft's mission aims to enhance understanding of planetary formation and the building blocks of our solar system.

science.title: Who Invented the Telescope?
science.summary: The telescope's invention is attributed to various figures, notably Dutch spectacle maker Hans Lippershey, who filed a patent application on October 2, 1608, for a two-lens device. Galileo Galilei later made significant advancements, enhancing its use in astronomy. Competing claims exist regarding the invention, highlighting the contributions of multiple individuals in the development of this groundbreaking optical instrument.

science.title: Tent5a Enzyme Regulates Insulin Production by Controlling Polyadenylation of Insulin mRNA
science.summary: A study in Nature Communications highlights the enzyme Tent5a's role in regulating insulin production in pancreatic beta cells. Researchers found that Tent5a controls the polyadenylation of insulin mRNA, influencing insulin synthesis. This discovery may enhance understanding of diabetes and insulin-related disorders, potentially leading to new therapeutic strategies. The findings underscore the importance of mRNA processing in hormone regulation.

entertainment.title: Bobby Deol says younger fans had 'forgotten' him, he had to do a Salman Khan film to remind people 'Bobby bhi koi hai'
entertainment.summary: Bobby Deol stated that younger fans had "forgotten" him, prompting his decision to act in Salman Khan's film Race 3 to re-establish his presence in the industry. The film marked a turning point in his career, leading to further successes with projects like Aashram and Animal, helping to revive his popularity among audiences.

entertainment.title: Janhvi Kapoor Unhappy with Peddi Role? Rumors Spark Debate
entertainment.summary: Rumors have emerged suggesting that Janhvi Kapoor is dissatisfied with her role in the upcoming film "Peddi," which is generating significant buzz ahead of its release next month. The film marks Ram Charan's return to theaters after a year-long hiatus. As anticipation builds among fans, discussions surrounding Kapoor's reported unhappiness have sparked debate within the industry.

entertainment.title: Salman forgives paps after hospital row but makes them say sorry 'zor se'
entertainment.summary: Salman Khan forgave paparazzi following a recent controversy during a hospital visit, asking them to apologize "zor se" at the Raja Shivaji success party in Mumbai. The actor lightened the mood by joking with photographers while posing alongside Riteish Deshmukh. This interaction transformed a previously tense situation into a more relaxed and humorous moment at the event.
